purpose: WP-027 S1 Phase-4-gate validation run for the acceptance criterion 'PhaseTracker reaches at least the registered 3.0 IP threshold in validation runs'. This is validation evidence for the Phase 4 gate, NOT Phase 7 campaign evidence and NOT a pre-registered scientific comparison (no effect sizes/confidence intervals against SlotAttention are claimed here) -- see DOCS/sessions/phase-7/0179-exp006-e1-temporal-binding-phasetracker-and-ablation-replication.md for that future work.

registered_threshold.description: The only PRINet 3.0 artifact using real generate_dataset/generate_temporal_clevr_n sequences with actually-trained (not random-weight) models, tied to a preregistration hash (y4q1_7_preregistration_hash.json).
